findings.passage: With a 3D printer that costs a few hundred and a digital file that can be downloaded online, someone can now manufacture an untraceable firearm at home. No background check, no serial number, and no accountability.
findings.note: Quoted by KATU/KOMO news story (published date given) at the House committee hearing on his HB 2320, describing home manufacture of untraceable guns with 3D printers.
